newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say Jan growth slower.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say Jan growth slower.

text.p: The Cincinnati chapter of the National Association of Purchasing Management said Friday in its January report that the rate of economic growth slowed.
"This is good news since it indicates that a concern that the rate of increase of the local economy was overheating seems to be less," the group said.
Commodity prices showed a four-month trend of increasing prices, it said.
"We would hope that the moderation in the rate of recovery for January would help contain this index," it said.
